**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 4.4 ("Audit Rights") is the sole audit/inspection right binding us as Corio, and it sits at or above the preferred position on all material terms:

| Term | Playbook preferred | Clause 4.4 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ≤ once / 12 months | "no more than once each calendar year" ✔ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | "upon reasonable notice" — required but unquantified (noted only) |
| Timing | Business hours | "at reasonable times" ✔ |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | independent CPA "reasonably acceptable to Corio" ✔ |
| Cost | Vendor's cost unless underpayment > 5% | Commerce One bears all costs; reimbursement only if underpayment > 5% ✔ |
| System access | None | Books and records only — no system access ✔ |

Exhibit B payment terms and the revenue-sharing provisions contain no separate verification or inspection right, so there is no second, less protective audit hook. The only gap versus preferred wording is the unquantified notice period; since notice is still mandatory (no unannounced audits) and cost allocation already uses the tighter 5% trigger, this is a minor sub-element recorded in the rationale rather than a deviation.
